name: comp-126
title: Avatar Upload Button
blurb: Avatar button with image preview and overlay remove button.
description: Single-image upload as a large square button. Preview fills the button; removal button appears as overlay when image is loaded.
use_when: Profile or team member avatar uploads where the preview is prominent.
avoid_when: Batch uploads or non-image file types.
a11y: Button has explicit aria-label. Remove button clearly labeled. Input hidden sr-only.
